sections.text:
**Program overview.** The **Extended Day Program**, mission "GROW to become followers of
Christ and GO make Him known to the world" (Matthew 28:19-20) — the "Grow and Go" framing.
Umbrella: Before School Care, Young Cougars Club (YCC), After School Care, Enrichment
Classes, Music Enrichment Lessons, plus Summer Adventures Camps. **Young Cougars Club** is
the kindergarten afternoon program: "a structured, literature based program with 3 rotations
(story, art and activities) with exciting and educational weekly themes." Eligibility: all
CCS students K-8; very limited spots for CCS siblings in a WEE School 4s/TK class.

**Hours (char-for-char).** Before School CCS K-5: 7:30-8:00 am. Before School WEE 4s/TK
siblings: 7:30-9:00 am. Young Cougars Club (K + WEE siblings): 1:15-3:00 pm. After School
(grades 1-8) / After YCC: 3:00-6:00 pm (MS arrive by 3:30; After YCC students join the
elementary group for the last hour at 5:00). **Latest pickup 6:00 pm.** A free Morning
Sibling Care (7:35 am, Worship Center) exists but is NOT part of Extended Day. On
early-dismissal days YCC/After School run a shortened schedule; both are closed the Friday
before Christmas break and the last day of school.

**Enrichment.** Enrichment Classes and Music Enrichment Lessons are offered within Extended
Day, but **2026-2027 offerings are NOT YET PUBLISHED** ("coming August 2026"). No specific
chess/clubs/instruments list is published for 26-27 yet.

**Registration.** Online application before school starts; space-limited, first-come
first-serve. Enrollment options: 5-day, 3-day, or drop-in. Billing through FACTS/Family
Portal. **Status per the web overview: "Registration for 2026-2027 is now full"** — an
operational status that does NOT affect the published hours/price data.

**Staff.** Debbie Yates, Director of Extended Day (yatesd@carmelchristian.org); Jen Schultz,
Assistant Director; Ingrid Hoover, Administrative Assistant. Main phone (704) 849-9723.
